slides.title: THE LOBBY DOOR THAT WON'T LOCK
Give the door its own power
slides.body: The door release gets a properly sized power supply, not the old buzzer transformer that feeds everything else.

slides.title: Make the door latch first
slides.body: Adjust the closer and line up the strike. An intercom can't lock a door that never shuts.

slides.title: Test the old riser wiring
slides.body: Corroded splices in old walls are how a brand-new panel dies in a month. Test before you mount.

slides.title: Add a backup way in
slides.body: App calling to a tenant's phone means one dead apartment station doesn't strand anyone outside.

slides.title: GET IT IN WRITING
slides.body: A written quote that names the panel, the power and the wiring plan. Text a photo of your door.
